title: FairQueue: Rethinking Prompt Learning for Fair Text-to-Image Generation

layout.note: Three stacked full-width tinted bands (pink observation, yellow analysis, green proposed solution), each with a rotated bold title at the left and three black-framed titled panels. Grey block arrows link panels in the first two bands; large plus and equals signs join the last.

lesson: Stack an analysis paper's argument as tinted bands (observation, analysis, solution) with three titled panels each, link panels with block arrows, and close with plus and equals signs so the fix and its results read as one equation.
